name: Suffolk County, NY
findings: Suffolk County has 4,054 nonprofit organizations. 1,643 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,359 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Suffolk County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
